introduction: Have you ever been looking for someone’s email address online but couldn’t find it? I know I have. Instead of going through the hassle of looking for someone’s email address, you can get a free email finder tool. What is an email finder tool? Email finder tools help you find professional business emails from various web pages. They work as chrome extensions or web apps. Email finder tools are beneficial for your business because they generate fresh leads. For example, if you are a recruitment team and want to look for candidates with specific skills, an email finder tool would be helpful since it helps you prospect the right people. If you already have a list of prospects who would need your product or services but do not have their contact details, you need an email finder tool. You can easily find all the required information through company websites, LinkedIn profiles, and other websites using just one tool. ContactOut is an email finder tool that simplifies the process of finding email contacts for potential leads. With its easy-to-use chrome extension, you can find email addresses on LinkedIn with just a few clicks. The chrome extension adds a sidebar overlay on LinkedIn displaying the contact information of the profile you are viewing. This can be really helpful when you are trying to gather information and contact someone who is not in your network. Whether you’re looking for business or personal contacts, ContactOut can definitely help you with that. Pricing Details: Free: $0 per month (40 emails/month, 3 phone numbers/month) Personal: $29 per month (150 emails/month, 15 phone numbers/month) Sales: $99 per month (500 emails/month, 50 phone numbers/month, Limited ATS integration, Salesforce integration Recruiter: $199 per month (1,000 emails/month, 50 phone numbers/month, Full ATS integration, Salesforce integration Team (Custom pricing)

sections.title: 2. Hunter.io
paragraphs: Hunter is an email finder tool that allows you to find email ids in bulk. By uploading a formatted CSV file with names or company names of the prospects, you can search email addresses and verify them in bulk. What’s more, Huntier.io can be integrated with Hubspot, Zapier, Salesforce, Pipedrive, and some more tools—so not only do you get an accurate list of emails for all your leads, but you can easily transfer that information into the software programs that will help your business thrive.
Pricing 500 searches and 1000 email validations for a $49 per month plan. 2,500 monthly searches for $99 and 10,000 monthly searches for $199. 30,000 monthly searches for $399 for business.

sections.title: 3. Prospect daddy
paragraphs: ProspectDaddy is a tool that will help you find verified business emails through LinkedIn and Gmail. ProspectDaddy also helps you with email-ready prospect lists, which you can directly import into your cold email software. ProspectDaddy is an extension for Chrome that helps YOU find the email addresses of every person on LinkedIn that could be interested in what you’re selling. No more tedious searches for contact information that only sometimes works—with ProspectDaddy, all you need is a name and a company, and we’ll give you their email address! ProspectDaddy can export to many tools for sales prospecting and CRM tools like Pipedrive, Hubspot, Salesforce, etc.
Pricing: ProspectDaddy is a free tool. 100 email addresses per month. SmartReach email automation tool gives you 5000 email ids of prospects every month.

sections.title: 4. Clearout
paragraphs: Clearout an affordable yet powerful email finder tool that helps you accurately find B2B email addresses. It allows you to find email addresses by typing the prospect’s name, company’s name, or domain. But it does more than just that—it also recognizes role-based emails for a more relevant prospect list based on your needs. You can even use it to clean up your existing email lists to ensure higher deliverability during your next big campaign. It helps remove all matching emails from your list and clears any invalid entries with just one click!
Pricing: $21 for 3000 monthly searches $58 for 10,000 monthly searches. Big Team -$350 for 100,000 monthly searches $625 for 250,000 monthly searches. No free plan.

sections.title: 5. LeadGibbon
paragraphs: LeadGibbon can be added to the Chrome browser as an extension. Thus, LinkedIn will show a small button in each profile visible to you, allowing you to save that person’s information in your LeadGibbon account. You can then create data sets using filters and optimize your outreach by creating a separate campaign for each set of people who have something in common. This could be the company they work at or their industry, or any other criteria you want. After creating campaigns and finding email addresses, it is possible to integrate LeadGibbon with tools like Zapier, Slack, etc., which will help you organize your data into actionable sets for further use.

Pricing : basic- 500 verified emails and 50 phone numbers at $49 per month. The most popular is 1500 emails and 150 phone numbers at $99 per month. business-4000 emails and 400 phone numbers at $199 per month. No free plan

sections.title: 6. Snov.io
paragraphs: Snow is the best cold email outreach automation platform that helps you generate good leads for your business. It has an email search tool with the option of single and bulk email search. In bulk email search, you can search up to 20,000 domains in one go. It provides free CRM and gives the full information about the prospect, including their social media handle, location, information about the company, etc. Snow’s high-rated email finder chrome extension helps you discover desired email addresses from websites you look onto. You can integrate Snow with Hubspot, Salesforce, Zoho CRM, LinkedIn lead generation forms, etc.

Pricing: 1000 searches for $33 per month small businesses 5000 searches for $83 per month. Companies 20,000 searches for $158 per month. Companies with larger teams of 50,000 searches for $308 per month. Enterprises 100,000 searches for $615 per month. No free plan is available

sections.title: 7. Lusha
paragraphs: Lusha is the best email finder tool for building relationships and generating business opportunities. It is a lead generation tool by which you can find phone numbers and email addresses within a few seconds. The Lusha phone number finder tool helps you in many ways. You can get the email address, phone number, location of headquarters, and other beneficial information of your prospect. It also searches prospects smoothly while you surf through different websites. The Lusha email finder can be integrated with Hubspot, Zapier, Gmail, Zoho, Pipedrive, etc. Lusha on LinkedIn enables you to instantly reveal the contact and company information of specific prospects and accounts that you’re looking for.

Pricing : The starter plan is for free five searches monthly professional plan 1-5 users and is $23 per month for 480 searches per month. The premium plan is $35 per month, with 1,680 monthly searches. Enterprises- custom plan, customize it according to specific requirements.

sections.title: 8. Voila Norbert
paragraphs: Voila, Norbert is an email finder tool that helps you find business email addresses. It searches by name, last name, and the company’s domain. It also shows social media details of the prospect, so you can get in touch with them on various platforms. The most interesting part is its in-built verifier, which ensures that it shows the verified results. The success rate is almost 98%. You can quickly get started with a free API key and integrate it with Node.js, PHP, Python, and Ruby. Voila, Norbert Email Finder Tool integrates with Google Chrome, Zapier, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Mailshake, Drip, ReplyApp, and Hubspot. Its email verification tool integrates with Mailchimp, SendGrid, Jotform, and Formstack.
Pricing: free version for 50 searches Paid plans for 1000 searches for $49 per month 5000 searches for $99 per month 15000 searches for $249 per month 50,000 searches for $499 per month
